ModMetaData.name: Resolve This Instead
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
Lets mods keep working when a mod they support has been replaced by a maintained continuation.
When a mod asks whether another mod is loaded (a patch guard, a MayRequire, ModsConfig.IsActive) and that mod is missing, this library answers yes if a known replacement of it is loaded. The replacements come from Use This Instead's data and from a small file that a mod can embed to vouch for a pair. An alias is applied only where a mod vouched for it, or where you switch it on in Mod options -> Resolve This Instead.
Not affiliated with or endorsed by Mlie. Use This Instead, by Mlie (MIT), is required: its data is read, not copied.
